send_toast.name: Send a toast
send_toast.description: Display a discreet toast at the top of the Shield screen.

color.name: Color
color.description: Accent color of the notification: RGB list, #RRGGBB or color name.

timeout.description: Seconds before the notification disappears. 0 keeps it until a button or the Back key is pressed.

buttons.description: Up to 4 buttons. Each one has a label, an optional id (reported in the event), optional actions to run when pressed (e.g. a script) and dismiss (default true).
